errata.claim: P9 / claim 9: every non-generic gap grows with r (S exponent 0.4 to 1.35)
errata.problem: No measurement at any r other than k=20. The D2 exponent is 0.5*e_poly+0.5 under the assumptions F ~ sqrt r and d ~ F; the D7 exponent 0.4 and the F4 exponent 0.53 are hard-coded in model.py; only the D4 exponents come from re-solving the model at other r.
errata.fix: Label the exponents and P9's outcome as derived (model extrapolation), not as a held prediction on measured data.

errata.problem: PROTOCOL.md mtime is 20:00:55, after every data file (19:49-20:00); the directory is untracked in git and there is no hash, commit or run log of the pre-data version, so the freeze cannot be verified.
errata.fix: State the freeze as an unverified assertion, or bind future protocols by hash/commit before the first run.

errata.claim: D2: norm/resultant decision costs d^1.70, 1,717x the per-point decision
errata.problem: The count is specific to the implementation (Karatsuba products plus a quadratic Euclidean gcd); it is not a lower bound. A half-gcd/quasi-linear implementation would cut the ratio to tens, not thousands.
errata.fix: Call it the measured cost of this implementation; keep only the Omega(d) argument as the general statement (the conclusion that D2 is far beyond 10x still holds).

errata.claim: Design table column C/r is measured coverage
errata.problem: The D3 rows use 300-trial hit rates (0.913, 0.897) as C/r, not enumerated coverage; the 'testing all orbit points costs 7.9x' figure is 7.74-7.91 across F.
errata.fix: Mark D3 C/r as sampled hit rate and give 7.7-7.9x.

errata.problem: The D5 F4 rows and the D2 polynomial rows have no group-op base-decoding setup (Gs = 0) while other rows charge 3F; their w=0 gaps (0.13, 1.4, 2.1) and the screen row's 0.44 are weight-0 artifacts of free native work.
errata.fix: Charge the same setup on every row and add a note that gaps below 1 at w=0 are not speedups (none are claimed as such).

errata.claim: Collision floor bounds the generic D4 hash (5.9x)
errata.problem: 5.9x is against measured rho-neg while the floor 6.15x is against model rho; numerically 5.9 < 6.15, which reads as a design under the floor unless the reference is stated each time.
errata.fix: Report D4 and the floor against the same reference (10.3x vs 6.15x of model rho).

errata.claim: D3 (P4): E[8]-closed base has the same decision cost per unknown
errata.problem: The equality (930/1826/2722) is by construction: the closure_reps arm runs the same per-representative code as the E[r]-only arm, so the cost match is tautological; only the hit rate is an empirical comparison.
errata.fix: Say the cost equality is by construction and only the hit-rate equality was tested.

refuted_claims: Every non-generic design with a defined exponent has a gap that grows with r (S exponent 0.4 to 1.35) [as a measured/held result: unsupported, model-derived only]
relabelling_check: No rho or BSGS design is presented as index calculus: the D1 screen row, D4 hash and D5 MITM are classed generic/BSGS-shaped and excluded from the trigger rule. No weight-0-only number is presented as a speedup.
notes: All headline numbers reproduce with independent code. The negative verdict (no non-generic oracle within 10x of rho-neg at w=0.1; no ecbench design triggered) is supported for the designs tested. Every result is an unverified assertion; no pcc claim exists.
